raised: Unclear whether the 3-year period counts from joining or from reaching retirement age
The page never says what the retirement age is
The bar comparison shows only a small gap, could even be negative, and leaves out the employer's money
The '123 מקור / מחושב / הזנתו' legend is confusing
Investment track buttons (S&P 500, אג"ח etc.) are not understood
Fund names with codes in the lock box (e.g. 13245, 4D) mean nothing
Codes TXH-09, KH-15, PF-18 mean nothing
No overall cap on direct expenses is a little worrying
The 47% withholding warning is frightening
The chief economist's recommendation to cut the benefit is worrying
Didn't know the chart cursor could be dragged
Fees are five times higher in the keren, which is bothersome
Grey tags in the word list are not understood
'הרווח הריאלי' is still not understood
Unclear whether 'משכורת קובעת' means gross salary
Unclear whether the under-60 tax rates mean it is cheaper for someone over 60
Unclear whether the 47% is refunded and whether they must file a report themselves
Unclear why higher fees still come out ahead
Missing: what happens if they leave or lose their job early
Missing: what happens to the money on death
Missing: effect on pension or allowances
Missing: amounts based on their own salary
Would drop the word list
Would drop the fund company cards
Would drop the 'חוקים וכללים · N' chips
Would drop the 'כמה זה עולה' table

problems.why: The reader takes the 7.5% to be the employer's deposit into the keren and never says it is unclear which fund it goes to. The closest point, whether 'משכורת קובעת' means gross salary, is a different problem.
